_about: ElevenLabs voice trial, round 2 (2026-11-14). Your note on round 1: every option sounded too energetic and frantic, almost yelling; only Lung Kwai B was OK. So this round is calm: Mom's library voices read one line at a time (like the game plays them) with eleven_multilingual_v2 at a steady, slower setting (round 1's eleven_v3 acts out every exclamation mark), and the designed voices are described as relaxed, soft and unhurried, with lower loudness. Lung Kwai B from round 1 is saved to the ElevenLabs account (voice id uVdDyRzePOo6H2RYCYSs) and plays first on his track to compare against. Made by scripts/voice-audition-eleven.mjs.

saltaunty.title: Pa Kluea, the salt aunty (pony)
lines: Sawasdee ka! I'm Pa Kluea. I make the salt!
Oh no! My salt jar is empty!
Will you be my salt carrier?

design.description: A relaxed, warm Thai aunty in her fifties from a quiet mountain village in northern Thailand. Calm, soft, unhurried and smiling, a gentle twinkle of humor, never loud or rushed, like chatting kindly over a cup of tea. Speaks English with a soft northern Thai accent.

kwai.title: Lung Kwai, the noodle-soup buffalo
lines: Blehh! My soup tastes like puddle water!
And the village dinner is tonight!

design.description: A big, easygoing Thai uncle in his sixties with a deep, mellow, relaxed voice and a soft chuckle. Calm and unhurried, warm and good-humored, never shouting, like a gentle cook chatting in his kitchen. Speaks English with a soft northern Thai accent.

kai.title: Pa Kai, the salty-egg hen
lines: Bawk! My salty eggs aren't salty!
Now my eggs will be salty!

design.description: A sweet, bright Thai auntie in her forties who sells salted eggs at a village market. A light, pleasant voice, cheerful but relaxed and unhurried, softly amused, never shrill or loud. Speaks English with a soft northern Thai accent, like a friendly character in a gentle animated film.

nak.title: Yai Nak, the otter grandma
lines: And my fish is so... plain.

design.description: A sweet old Thai grandmother in her eighties with a soft, slow, quiet voice and a tiny giggle. Calm, cozy and tender, never loud, like telling a bedtime story. Calls everyone dear. Speaks English with a soft northern Thai accent.
